fixes.name: deployment.set-probes
fixes.description: Change the timing of a container's existing liveness, readiness or startup probes: initialDelaySeconds, periodSeconds, timeoutSeconds, failureThreshold, and successThreshold for readiness. Give only the fields to change, with the values the evidence supports. It can't add or remove a probe, or change what the probe calls.

root_causes.name: probe_too_strict_for_startup
root_causes.description: the app works but takes longer to start than its probes allow, so they fail it before it is ready

root_causes.name: probe_timeout_too_short
root_causes.description: the app answers its probes, but slower than their timeout allows

root_causes.name: new_version_broken
root_causes.description: a recent rollout brought a version that fails, where the one before it worked

root_causes.name: application_bug
root_causes.description: its code fails, whichever revision runs

root_causes.name: other
root_causes.description: none of these: say what in the summary

root_causes.name: cannot_be_scheduled
root_causes.description: no node can take its pods, for lack of CPU or memory, a taint, or an affinity or node selector no node matches

root_causes.name: image_pull_failure
root_causes.description: its image can't be pulled, for a wrong name or tag, or missing registry credentials

root_causes.name: volume_unavailable
root_causes.description: a volume it needs can't be bound or mounted

root_causes.name: init_container_failure
root_causes.description: an init container fails or never finishes

root_causes.name: startup_config_error
root_causes.description: a ConfigMap, Secret or key its containers need is missing, so they can't start

root_causes.name: quota_exceeded
root_causes.description: a namespace quota refuses new pods

root_causes.name: still_starting
root_causes.description: its pods are starting slowly and nothing has failed

guidance:
From the probe-restart-storm profile, which offers deployment.set-probes:
Changing a probe's timing is right when the application works and the
probe fails it only because it is slower than the probe allows: it is
killed while still starting (killed_during_startup), or its probes time
out (probe_timeouts) on answers that come a little after the probe's
timeout. The logs then show it starting or serving normally until it is
stopped, and crashed_on_its_own is false. Each revision's probe timings
are in the rollout history: compare them with how long containers ran and
with the probe failure messages.

Decide which probes to change and to what, from that evidence: liveness,
readiness or startup, and initialDelaySeconds, periodSeconds,
timeoutSeconds, failureThreshold or, for readiness, successThreshold.
Give the values the evidence supports, such as a timeout above the
answers' latency, or enough delay or failures to cover the start the logs
show, and cite them. A readiness probe made more lenient keeps sending
traffic to pods that fail it for longer: change it only when the
evidence shows readiness failing a pod that serves.

Don't change a probe, and say what you found instead, when:
- the application is failing: errors or stack traces in the logs,
  crashed_on_its_own is true, or probes get error answers from a
  container that is up. A probe failing is then a symptom.
- a recent rollout (rollout_recent) brought the failures and the revision
  before it worked: whether to roll back is another kind of incident's
  call, unless the logs show the new version only starts slower.
- something the application calls is down, and its readiness probe says
  so: a more lenient probe would send traffic to pods that can't serve
  it, and hide the outage.
- probe_kills and probe_timeouts are both false: nothing shows the probes
  failing a container that works.

From the stuck-pods profile, which offers no fix:
No fix is on offer for these incidents: Themis diagnoses them and hands
them to a person. Tell which cause keeps the pods from becoming ready,
from the pod states and the events, and back it with the check that shows
it: scheduler_rejected_pods, image_pull_failing, volume_not_bound,
init_container_stuck, config_error_on_start or quota_refused_pods. When
the checks and the evidence point to one cause, conclude with it and cite
that evidence. When none fails and the pods are only slow, say so. When
the evidence can't tell, say what is missing.

A recent rollout doesn't make this a regression to roll back: rolling
back belongs to another kind of incident, and is never on offer here.

templates.name: rollout_history
templates.description: The Deployment's rollout progress, conditions, GitOps ownership markers, and each ReplicaSet revision with its images and resource limits.

templates.name: pod_states
templates.description: Each pod of the Deployment: its revision, readiness, and each container's state and last termination (where OOMKilled shows).

templates.name: target_events
templates.description: Recent events of the Deployment, its ReplicaSets and its pods, newest first.

templates.name: referenced_config
templates.description: The ConfigMaps and Secrets the pod template refers to, and when each ConfigMap last changed. Names and times only, never values.

templates.name: container_logs_tail
templates.description: The end of one container's logs. Defaults to the pod needing attention most, from the run that last ended.

predicates.name: probe_kills
predicates.reason: an event says Pod/orders-8a6c2e4f1-d2f4g: Container app failed liveness probe, will be restarted, but no container of that pod of revision 15 was killed and restarted since

predicates.name: probe_timeouts
predicates.reason: a probe failed other than by running out of time: Pod/orders-8a6c2e4f1-d2f4g: Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 503

predicates.name: killed_during_startup
predicates.reason: no container of revision 15 was stopped as soon as its liveness probe could fail it

predicates.name: crashed_on_its_own
predicates.reason: no container ended with an error or ran out of memory; any that ended were stopped

predicates.name: scheduler_rejected_pods
predicates.reason: the 3 pod(s) that aren't ready were all scheduled

predicates.name: image_pull_failing
predicates.reason: no container of the 3 pod(s) that aren't ready is waiting for its image

predicates.name: volume_not_bound
predicates.reason: no event says a volume of the 3 pod(s) that aren't ready can't be bound or mounted

predicates.name: init_container_stuck
predicates.reason: no init container of the 3 pod(s) that aren't ready failed or ran longer than 5m0s

predicates.name: config_error_on_start
predicates.reason: no container waits for its configuration, and every ConfigMap the pods need exists

predicates.name: quota_refused_pods
predicates.reason: no event says a quota refused a pod

predicates.name: stuck_pods_new_revision_only
predicates.reason: revision 14 has no ready pods to compare with
